<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard AUR packaging practices for npm-based packages, as documented in the referenced Arch Wiki Node.js package guidelines. The source is fetched from the official npm registry using a checksum-verified tarball, and no suspicious commands (eval, base64, curl, wget) appear anywhere in the file.

All operations in the package() function are standard: npm global install into $pkgdir, ownership fixing, removal of internal fields from package.json files using sed and jq (to make the package relocatable), and symlinking of documentation files. File operations are confined to $pkgdir, and no modifications are made outside this staging directory. The jq filter `with_entries(select(.key|test("_.+")|not))` is a common operation to strip private npm metadata fields, and the `sed '/_where/d'` pattern removes npm install path references.

The only network activity is the source download from registry.npmjs.org, which is the expected and correct source for an npm-packaged application. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, code injection, backdoors, or execution of untrusted downloaded code.</arg_value><details>
There are no genuinely malicious behaviors detected. The file is consistent with ordinary npm package AUR packaging.</details>
